course.title: Product Design -II
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: Babies are born in a state of the rate of one birth every 12 minutes. The time between birth follows exponential distribution. Find-
i) The average number of births per year
ii) The probability that no birth will occur in any one day.
iii) The probability of issuing50 birth certificates in 3 hours, given that no certificates were issued during the first 2 hours of the 3 hours period.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
